title: Diptych with Discs and Flowers
description: Diptych collage presenting mirrored left and right panels — white-ground and black-ground — each populated with compact discs, yellow flower motifs, red and turquoise triangles, target circles, and dense handwritten marks. Photographic fragments, geometric shapes, and crossed lines punctuate both halves symmetrically.
composition: bilateral diptych with mirrored black-white halves
keywords: compact disc and triangle geometric collage
